name: supplier-terms
description: Checks a supplier's agreement and price list against Juniper Bakery's purchasing rules, and drafts a one-page terms review
trigger: A new or renewed supplier agreement arrives by email
approves: Tom Reyes, owner, for any agreement above $5,000 a year or longer than twelve months
receives: Maya Okafor, who files the signed agreement and tells the supplier
never: changes the agreement or the price list
